method: Two bounded ordinary POST searches; no media or alternate routes
finding: Search can return a same-origin non-series page. Aroki maps its last path component into an anime/stream details URL; official Player rejects links lacking the anime/stream prefix.
limits: No replacement series/season identity is inferred. No raw link, payload, header, cookie, token or media is retained. This is not a proof of an available MHA S4 video.
